text:
maria-enginfra: FYI seeing a flapping liveness pattern for dedicated-node pool northstar-4 since ~09:05 UTC. Several tenants got their connections moved and egress quotas temporarily reduced. customers reported 5-10s tail latency spikes.

sam-sre: saw the alert. ops-bot reported 6 liveness retries + immediate node-quarantine. looks correlated with a kernel OOM in that rack earlier.

ops-bot: alert: node=northstar-4-12 liveness_failed=6 reason=kv-cache-thread-hang probe_duration=12s

jing-allocator: quarantine flow is our current reaction: on 3 failed probes we mark node as drained and trigger reschedule. but the reschedule flows are saturating egress policers in the topology.

maria-enginfra: the problematic bit — when we quarantine, we trigger immediate tenant rebinds to other GPUs and that causes bursts of egress (kvcache sync + model pull). egress policers are then tripping and applying the soft-throttle, which slows the rebind and causes additional probe timeouts -> cascade.

nate-net: yes, saw p95 egress per-node jump from 30MB/s to ~220MB/s for a 20s window. our policer windows are small in eu-south; they're doing drop+throttle on excess, so retransmits + backpressure show up as latency.

lia-product: a couple of customers on Dedicated noticed throughput drop and were escalated. they want a short RCA and mitigation asap.

sam-sre: immediate mitigation idea: change quarantine from immediate to soft-quarantine: mark node read-only for new allocations, let existing sessions drain for 30s before moving. reduces rebind storm. low-risk config change.

jing-allocator: agree. also we can make the probe algo slightly friendlier: extend probe timeout from 10s -> 20s and change threshold from 3->5. That will avoid false-positives during short GC/kernel stalls. config snippet:
```
allocator.probe.timeout=20s
allocator.probe.fail_threshold=5
allocator.quarantine.mode=soft
allocator.quarantine.drain_window=30s
```

maria-enginfra: sounds good. what's the cost? if node is genuinely dead we delay reallocs by ~30s. for critical tenants we can bypass and force failover. we should surface an annotation so sales/CS know when bypass used.

nate-net: also propose egress smoothing: when we rebind tenants off a node, add gradual ramp-up to their egress token bucket for 15s (linear). that reduces the spike hitting the policer. low-inv impact.

sam-sre: I'll push a canary of the probe timeout + soft-quarantine to eu-south canary pool at 09:45 UTC, and we can monitor rebind egress burst. can someone add a metric graph for per-node egress 1s/5s and queue depth?

lia-product: tagging support ops and a couple account managers. please capture customer impact and timeframe.

maria-enginfra: creating a short runbook for oncall: if similar cascade happens, do: 1) disable immediate-quarantine on node 2) gracefully scale up warm pool by +10% in region 3) notify customers + CS 4) run kernel OOM remediation.

ops-bot: runbook created: /runbooks/node-quarantine-cascade (id=rb-7882). assigned to sam-sre for canary.

jing-allocator: also adding a postmortem action: add a preflight check before rebind that asks 'will this rebind push any egress policer >80%?' if yes, either stagger or spill to shared-surge-pool.

sam-sre: rolling out canary now. will report back in 30m.

nate-net: quick note for infra cost: soft-quarantine + ramping means more transient GPU usage and slightly higher egress bursts over longer windows, but expected to reduce repeated reschedules (which have far higher cost).

maria-enginfra: agreed. prefer small predictable cost in exchange for stability. if canary looks good we'll flip region-by-region.

sam-sre: canary metric update: after applying soft-quarantine in eu-south-canary, rebind egress peak dropped ~65% and probe false positives stopped. pushing to eu-south-wide in 10m.

lia-product: thanks team, I'll update the impacted customers and log the timeline in the ticket.

maria-enginfra: great work. follow-ups: (1) jem to draft RFC for ramped egress tokens (2) add warm-pool auto-increment on probe storms (3) telemetry alert for 'rebind storm' pattern. I'll assign owners in the follow-up thread.

sam-sre: reopening when we need action items. :thumbsup:
